code_python3:
class Solution:
    def nodesBetweenCriticalPoints(self, head):
        crits = []
        prev, curr = head, head.next
        idx = 1
        while curr and curr.next:
            if (curr.val > prev.val and curr.val > curr.next.val) or \
               (curr.val < prev.val and curr.val < curr.next.val):
                crits.append(idx)
            prev = curr
            curr = curr.next
            idx += 1
        if len(crits) < 2:
            return [-1, -1]
        min_d = min(crits[i+1]-crits[i] for i in range(len(crits)-1))
        return [min_d, crits[-1]-crits[0]]

title: Number of Equal Count Substrings
key_insight: 枚举不同字符数k，滑动窗口大小为k*count，检查是否所有出现的字符频率都等于count
approach: 枚举count和窗口中字符种类数，滑动窗口验证
code_python3:
class Solution:
    def equalCountSubstrings(self, s: str, count: int) -> int:
        n = len(s)
        res = 0
        for k in range(1, 27):
            w = k * count
            if w > n: break
            freq = [0]*26
            valid = 0
            for i in range(n):
                idx = ord(s[i]) - ord('a')
                freq[idx] += 1
                if freq[idx] == count: valid += 1
                elif freq[idx] == count+1: valid -= 1
                if i >= w:
                    idx2 = ord(s[i-w]) - ord('a')
                    freq[idx2] -= 1
                    if freq[idx2] == count: valid += 1
                    elif freq[idx2] == count-1: valid -= 1
                if valid == k: res += 1
        return res

title: Walking Robot Simulation II
key_insight: 机器人沿网格边界走，对步数取模避免重复绕圈
approach: 计算周长，步数取模后模拟沿边界移动，注意方向
code_python3:
class Robot:
    def __init__(self, width, height):
        self.w = width
        self.h = height
        self.perimeter = 2*(width+height) - 4
        self.pos = 0
    def step(self, num):
        self.pos = (self.pos + num) % self.perimeter
        if self.pos == 0: self.pos = self.perimeter
    def getPos(self):
        p = self.pos % self.perimeter
        if p == 0: p = self.perimeter
        if p < self.w: return [p, 0]
        p -= self.w - 1
        if p < self.h: return [self.w-1, p]
        p -= self.h - 1
        if p < self.w: return [self.w-1-p, self.h-1]
        p -= self.w - 1
        return [0, self.h-1-p]
    def getDir(self):
        p = self.pos % self.perimeter
        if p == 0: p = self.perimeter
        if 0 < p < self.w: return 'East'
        if self.w-1 < p < self.w+self.h-2: return 'North'
        if self.w+self.h-3 < p < 2*self.w+self.h-3: return 'West'
        return 'South'

title: Most Beautiful Item for Each Query
key_insight: 按价格排序后维护前缀最大美丽值，对每个查询二分找最大可负担美丽值
approach: 排序items，计算前缀最大beauty，对每个query二分查找
code_python3:
class Solution:
    def maximumBeauty(self, items, queries):
        import bisect
        items.sort()
        prices = [p for p, _ in items]
        max_beauty = [0]*len(items)
        max_beauty[0] = items[0][1]
        for i in range(1, len(items)):
            max_beauty[i] = max(max_beauty[i-1], items[i][1])
        ans = []
        for q in queries:
            idx = bisect.bisect_right(prices, q) - 1
            ans.append(max_beauty[idx] if idx >= 0 else 0)
        return ans

title: Maximum Number of Tasks You Can Assign
key_insight: 二分答案k，贪心检查能否用workers+pills完成k个最小的任务
approach: 二分可完成任务数，贪心验证：对最简单的k个任务用最强的k个工人匹配，用药丸增强
code_python3:
class Solution:
    def maxTaskAssign(self, tasks, workers, pills, strength):
        from sortedcontainers import SortedList
        tasks.sort()
        workers.sort()
        def can(k):
            if k == 0: return True
            t = tasks[:k]
            sl = SortedList(workers[-k:])
            p = pills
            for i in range(k-1, -1, -1):
                if sl[-1] >= t[i]:
                    sl.pop()
                elif p > 0:
                    idx = sl.bisect_left(t[i] - strength)
                    if idx == len(sl): return False
                    sl.pop(idx)
                    p -= 1
                else:
                    return False
            return True
        lo, hi = 0, min(len(tasks), len(workers))
        while lo < hi:
            mid = (lo+hi+1)//2
            if can(mid): lo = mid
            else: hi = mid-1
        return lo

key_insight: 用前缀和或滑动窗口计算以每个位置为中心、半径为k的子数组平均值

code_python3:
class Solution:
    def getAverages(self, nums, k):
        n = len(nums)
        ans = [-1]*n
        if 2*k+1 > n: return ans
        window_sum = sum(nums[:2*k+1])
        ans[k] = window_sum // (2*k+1)
        for i in range(k+1, n-k):
            window_sum += nums[i+k] - nums[i-k-1]
            ans[i] = window_sum // (2*k+1)
        return ans

approach: DFS找从根到start和dest的路径，去除公共前缀后拼接
code_python3:
class Solution:
    def getDirections(self, root, startValue, destValue):
        def find(node, val, path):
            if not node: return False
            if node.val == val: return True
            path.append('L')
            if find(node.left, val, path): return True
            path.pop()
            path.append('R')
            if find(node.right, val, path): return True
            path.pop()
            return False
        path_s, path_d = [], []
        find(root, startValue, path_s)
        find(root, destValue, path_d)
        i = 0
        while i < len(path_s) and i < len(path_d) and path_s[i] == path_d[i]:
            i += 1
        return 'U'*(len(path_s)-i) + ''.join(path_d[i:])
